_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: T3 BBV (Besluit Begroting en Verantwoording) municipality-level compliance overlay (REQ-BBV-001..009). Additively enriches the BbvAccountMapping and BbvTaakveld schemas already declared by add-shillinq-bookkeeping-operations: BbvTaakveld gains the REQ-BBV-005 catalogue fields (name, category, legalBasis, effectiveFrom, effectiveTo, bbvVersion) so it doubles as the canonical Besluit BBV bijlage IV master per design.md D2; BbvAccountMapping gains _meta.source plus a stronger uniqueness constraint so per-administration overrides are first-class. Extends T1 GLTransaction.post lifecycle with the BBV-mapping precondition scoped to gemeente/provincie/waterschap administration types and forward-only by postingDate (REQ-BBV-003 / design D3) — declared via x-openregister-lifecycle.preconditions per ADR-031, not a service class. No source-code orchestrator: a thin OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\BbvComplianceGuard provides the single declarative seam OR's lifecycle engine cannot yet express (cross-schema FK presence + administration-type scope + postingDate gating). x-openregister-aggregations on BbvAccountMapping documents the standard BBV reporting roll-ups — operator views consume them; no PHP BbvReportingService walks the GL. Sibling specs bookkeeping-iv3-reporting and bookkeeping-bcf-vat-compensation already consume BbvAccountMapping fields (iv3Bucket, bcfCompensable, compensablePercentage) so this fragment does not redeclare them; it only adds the missing REQ-BBV-005/REQ-BBV-008 surface. Manifest navigation lives in src/manifest.json (already declared); the repair step seeder lives in lib/Repair/InitializeSettings.php (extended in this change).

BbvTaakveld.description: Canonical BBV taakveld catalogue entry per Besluit BBV bijlage IV. Seeded from bbv-taakvelden-2024.json with _meta.bbvVersion: "2024". Versioned: a future revision ships as bbv-taakvelden-YYYY.json with a new _meta.bbvVersion stamp; both coexist (design.md D2). Each record carries the canonical Bestuur..VHROSV category structure plus a legal-basis citation and a validity window for catalogue revisions. The schema doubles as the enum source for BbvAccountMapping.taakveld (T3 bookkeeping-bbv-compliance).

name.description: Official taakveld name per Besluit BBV bijlage IV. Mirrors `description` for catalogue revisions that want a distinct short label; defaults to the description value when omitted.
name.title: Name

category.description: Canonical category structure per Besluit BBV bijlage IV. The enum mirrors the bijlage IV chapter ordering — every record SHOULD carry exactly one. Operators MAY add records without a category to track sub-taakvelden, but those records are excluded from the standard category roll-ups.
category.title: Category

legalBasis.description: Statutory citation per REQ-BBV-005, e.g. `Besluit BBV bijlage IV §0.1`. Used by the audit-pack and the IV3 export to evidence the catalogue source.
legalBasis.title: Legal Basis

effectiveFrom.description: First date this taakveld code is valid per the BBV revision in _meta.bbvVersion. Records without effectiveFrom default to the BBV revision's effective date.
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Last date this taakveld code is valid. null = currently valid. A revised code is added as a new record with effectiveFrom set; the prior record is closed by setting effectiveTo to the day before.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

BbvAccountMapping.description: Per-administration mapping from an RGS account to its BBV taakveld + programma + paragraaf + autorisatieniveau. Operator-overrideable; default seeded from lib/Settings/seeds/rgs-to-bbv-mapping.json. Carries bcfCompensable + compensablePercentage driving BCF claim aggregation (REQ-BCF-002/004) and iv3Bucket driving IV3 export. Unique per (administrationId, accountNumber) — exactly one mapping per account per administration (REQ-BBV-002 scenario). T3 bookkeeping-bbv-compliance.

_meta.description: Audit-traceability metadata per REQ-BBV-002 / REQ-BBV-006. `_meta.source = "seeded"` on records created by the repair step from rgs-to-bbv-mapping.json; `_meta.source = "operator-edited"` after operator override. The repair-step idempotency check uses this flag to skip operator-edited records on re-run.

source.description: Origin tag — `seeded` for records created by the repair step from the bundled seed, `operator-edited` for operator overrides. Drives the idempotent re-seed behaviour per REQ-BBV-006.
source.title: Source

bbvVersion.description: BBV revision the mapping was seeded against, e.g. `2024`. Lets operators see at a glance which revision a record dates from when revisions coexist (Risk 1 in proposal.md).
bbvVersion.title: BBV Version

_meta.title: Meta

byProgrammaCode.description: Per-programmaCode roll-up of posted GL amounts within an administration, sourced via the BbvAccountMapping → GLLine join. Drives the BBV programma-summary view; sibling spec bookkeeping-iv3-reporting consumes a similar shape for IV3 export. Declared declaratively per ADR-031 — no PHP BbvReportingService walks the GL.

byAutorisatieniveau.description: Per-autorisatieniveau (programma / taakveld / kostenplaats) roll-up of posted GL amounts per REQ-BBV-004. Surfaces the level at which raadsautorisatie applies. Declared declaratively (ADR-031).
